message:
`context="module"` is deprecated, use the `module` attribute instead
https://svelte.dev/e/script_context_deprecated

Using `on:change` to listen to the change event is deprecated. Use the event attribute `onchange` instead
https://svelte.dev/e/event_directive_deprecated

`visible` is updated, but is not declared with `$state(...)`. Changing its value will not correctly trigger updates
https://svelte.dev/e/non_reactive_update
